scope: Independent session-sandbox execution of the bounded C mirror for the tested fraction core, including repeated GCC/Clang runs, exhaustive finite corpus execution, capacity-event observation, sanitizer runs, and persistence of the evidence references needed to reconstruct the milestone.

source_code.role: exact C public interface used by the milestone
exact bounded C mirror implementation used by the milestone

tests.role: C test harness executed in the session sandbox
Python proof corpus used as the semantic reference lineage

vectors.role: deterministic generator for the 608400 finite fraction-pair corpus

logs.role: phase-2 correction and repeated C-corpus log

fingerprints.role: Git blob identifiers and SHA-256 of the persisted session archive

results.role: observed repeated GCC/Clang results and sanitizer observations
proof-status matrix separating finite evidence from general proof

documentation.role: R9 doctrine and candidate PFR invariants
material-continuity rule governing this and future solid milestones

limitations: The current C mirror is bounded and does not yet implement multi-precision promotion and exact resume.
The finite 608400-pair corpus is not a universal proof over all rational inputs.
The session sandbox is ephemeral; this manifest persists references to the evidence but does not make the original execution environment permanent.
GitHub Actions failure previously observed is an independent infrastructure state and is not resolved by this milestone.
The manifest validator establishes structural completeness of the seven evidence families, not scientific truth or correctness of each referenced artifact.
